name: Golden Gate Bridge
desc: Walk 1.7 miles of international orange through fog that arrives like clockwork. Free, iconic, bring a windproof soul.

name: Alcatraz Island
desc: The Rock: a ferry, a haunted cellblock, an audio tour by former guards. Book weeks out; escape attempts extra.

name: Golden Gate Park
desc: Bigger than Central Park, with bison. Actual bison. Free roaming for you; they're the ones fenced in.

name: Pier 39
desc: Sea lions took over a dock in 1989 and never left. The loudest free comedy show in town.

name: Cable Cars
desc: Hang off the running board of a moving national landmark for eight bucks. Hills drop away like a movie shot.

name: Ferry Building Marketplace
desc: Saturday farmers market outside, oysters and sourdough inside. Sample your way to a free-ish lunch.

name: Lands End
desc: Cliff trails, shipwreck views, the ruins of Sutro Baths. Feels like the edge of the world because it is.

name: Palace of Fine Arts
desc: A Roman ruin built on purpose in 1915, ringed by swans. The most proposal-photographed rotunda in the West.

name: Twin Peaks
desc: Huff up for the full 360° city sparkle. Bring a hoodie; Karl the Fog attends most evenings.

name: Coit Tower
desc: Depression-era murals downstairs are free; the elevator view costs a burrito. Climb the Filbert Steps to earn it.
